preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are at least 2, and walking time w is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid contains exactly n rows, each with exactly m integers.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= cell <= 10**9 for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell value is between -1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The start cell (0,0) and end cell (n-1, m-1) are not prohibited.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (if unreachable) or the minimum time required to reach the destination.
The result is -1 if and only if there is no valid path from start to end.
The result is non-negative if and only if a valid path exists.
If reachable, the result is the minimum of the time using only walking and the time using at least one portal transition.
walk_only_time is the shortest path cost using only adjacent moves with cost w.

portal_time is the minimum cost to reach the destination using at least one portal jump, calculated as min(start_to_portal_i + portal_i_cost + portal_j_cost + portal_j_to_end) for all valid portal pairs i, j.
